args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry – 10 People in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I am organising a group stay for 10 people at City Hub Tokyo in June. Could you please let me know about availability for that month, along with any group rates or conditions that apply?

Please let me know what further details you need (exact dates, room configuration, etc.).

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the address in one of City Hub's guest reviews. The hotel is listed as "City Hub" in Tokyo.

The email asks about availability for 10 people in June, plus any group rates or conditions. It also asks what other details they need, such as exact dates and room setup. It's signed from you at Blue Sparrow Tech.

You didn't give exact dates, so I left them out. When they reply, you may need to send those.
